gallery.source: Riverside path and Northern Spire, Sunderland (geograph 5963579)
gallery.description:
This path along the north bank of the River Wear is for use by pedestrians and cyclists. It forms part of the C2C cycle route across northern England, from the Cumbrian coast to the North Sea. The C2C is part of the National Cycle Network.
On the approach to Sunderland, cyclists are now greeted by this sight of the Northern Spire, which was completed in 2018.

gallery.title: File:Fridel Meyer (8).JPG
gallery.description:
Fridel Engert née Meyer (1904–1982), known to the public at that time as Fridel Meyer and in later years as Fridel Dalling-Hay, having set out in her kayak from Westminster, London, England, with the intention of circumnavigating the UK. Here she poses at the Wear, Sunderland, with the Mayor of Sunderland, Alderman E.H. Brown.

Note: A full attempt has been made, via libraries, books, magazines, collections, archives, internet etc., to establish the name of the author. None has been found.
